title: keyDoor
responsibility: Provide key-door collision mechanics and a complete branching game document for either dimension.

inputs.name: keyDoor.state
inputs.description: Read-only game state evaluated without modifying the supplied snapshot.

inputs.name: keyDoor.input
inputs.description: Movement deltas and optional branch choice for one deterministic key-door tick.

inputs.name: exampleDocument.dimension
inputs.description: Requested 2D or 3D native game example dimension.

outputs.name: keyDoor
outputs.description: Updated state with bounded movement, key/door collision behavior and the selected garden or vault choice.

outputs.name: exampleDocument
outputs.description: Versioned game document containing the key-door scene, mechanics contract and branching checkpoints.
